However, to express this in a standard recursive form without tracking the count of repetitions, we can simplify it as:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}

a(n-1) & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

This formula captures the decreasing phase and the increasing repetition phase.
